Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!



Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322\-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.



As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.



Work\-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year\-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.



Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

This position is responsible for all academic support services and community engagement for designated state support and self\-support Master of Business Administration (MBA) programs and Master of Science (MS) graduate programs including, but not limited to, on\-line admission processes, academic counseling, probation counseling, and monitoring of academic progress to meet degree requirements. * Graduate Admissions
* Advising graduate students
* Cohort administration
* Office administration \& Other duties as assigned

COB Graduate Programs Office



### **Time Base**



1\.0 time\-base, 40 hours per week.



### **Duration of Appointment**



This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.



### **Classification**



Student Services Professional III



### **Compensation**



Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.


* Hiring Range: The hiring range for this position is $5,540 \- $6,182 per month commensurate with candidate's education, experience, skills, and training.
* CSU Classification Salary Range: The CSU Classification Salary Range for this position is $5,540 \- $7,893 per month.

### **Benefits**



At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well\-being.



To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half\-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on appointment type, classification, and applicable collective bargaining agreement. Eligible employees may have access to a comprehensive benefits package that can include:


* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 24 vacation days per year (based on employee group and/or length of service), 14 paid holidays, and 12 sick days annually with unlimited accrual.
* **Health Coverage:** A variety of medical, dental, and vision plans.
* **Retirement Plans:** Participation in the CalPERS defined benefit plan, along with voluntary savings options such as 403(b), 401(k), and 457 plans.
* **Educational Benefits:** Tuition fee waiver programs for eligible employees; dependent eligibility varies by employee group and bargaining unit.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.
* **Additional Benefits:** Wellness programs, professional development opportunities, and insurance options including life, disability, and pet insurance.


Candidates are encouraged to review the appropriate CSU Employee Benefits Summary for details specific to their position. Additionally, the CSU Total Compensation Calculator is available to help prospective employees understand the full value of the CSU benefits package and how it complements base salary.

This position is a student\-focused higher education professional with experience in graduate recruitment, admissions, advising, and program administration. They excel at engaging prospective students through outreach events, presentations, virtual information sessions, and personalized follow\-up, while effectively managing admissions processes through systems such as Salesforce, WebAdmit, and Cal State Apply. They provide comprehensive academic advising, helping students navigate degree requirements, university policies, enrollment, and academic progress, while connecting them to campus resources that support their success.



The ideal candidate is highly organized and collaborative, with the ability to coordinate orientations, student engagement activities, graduation events, and career development initiatives that foster a strong graduate student community. They maintain accurate student records, monitor enrollment trends, assist with course scheduling, and work closely with faculty, administrators, and campus partners to ensure efficient program operations. Committed to exceptional customer service, they support office fun

jobs.title: Billing & Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Cage \& Miles is one of the largest and fastest\-growing family law firms in Southern California. Our clients trust us to guide them through some of the most important moments of their lives, and we take that responsibility seriously. We are committed to delivering exceptional service through a team of talented professionals who lead with expertise, compassion, and integrity.



Our growth is fueled by a culture that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and investing in our people. We believe great teams don't happen by accident \- they are built through mentorship, professional development, clear expectations, and opportunities to grow.



As we continue to expand, we're looking for individuals who are motivated, client\-focused, and excited to help shape the future of our firm. If you're looking for a place where your contributions matter and your career can grow alongside the organization, we'd love to meet you.  

  

**Job Summary:**

The Billing \& Account Coordinator oversees a portfolio of client matters for assigned attorneys, ensuring accounts are managed with both urgency and care. This client\-facing role requires strong subject\-matter expertise in billing, collections, and account management. The ideal candidate is a polished, confident communicator who takes ownership of tasks from start to finish, works efficiently, and makes sound decisions. Strong problem\-solving skills and emotional intelligence are essential when addressing account issues and navigating difficult conversations with empathy, sound judgment, and respect. The right candidate is proactive and detail\-oriented, takes pride in maintaining accurate, audit\-ready work, and contributes to a supportive, collaborative team while delivering consistently positive client experience.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage a portfolio of client matters, ensuring accurate billing, collections, trust balances, and account activity while keeping accounts in good standing.
* Monitor accounts to identify outstanding balances, upcoming financial needs, and potential issues, using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.
* Partner closely with attorneys and paralegals to communicate account status, address retainer needs and resolve financial matters.
* Proactively communicate with clients by phone, email, and text regarding billing, outstanding balances, payments, and account concerns with professionalism and empathy.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, using sound judgment, problem\-solving skills, and firm systems to work efficiently and accurately.
* Maintain precise, audit\-ready documentation and contribute to a collaborative team environment while maintaining confidentiality and providing a consistently positive client experience.


**Qualifications:**


* Experience in customer service, account management, collections, billing, client relations, or a similar client\-facing role; prior law firm or professional services experience is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence and experience communicating by phone, email, and text.
* Strong emotional intelligence, interpersonal skills, and the ability to navigate sensitive or difficult conversations with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage a high volume of client matters, prioritize competing demands, and maintain accurate, audit\-ready records.
* Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to take initiative, make sound decisions, identify issues, and follow through without constant direction.
* Comfortability discussing financial matters, including billing, outstanding balances, payments, and retainers, while maintaining a professional and client\-focused approach.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; college education in business, accounting, finance, or a related field is preferred.

  


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); experience with Clio, Super Set, or similar account management systems is a plus.

  


**Additional Information:**


* This position can be fully remote or hybrid, with the option to work out of any of our offices, Monday – Friday from 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m

  


* The anticipated compensation for this role is $22 \- $26 per hour, but ultimately will depend on experience.

  


* Cage \& Miles has been named a Top Workplace by the San Diego Union \-Tribune, ranking \#2 among businesses with 50\-149 employees. This is a meaningful achievement driven by the voices of our employees and our shared commitment to excellence.

· Demonstrated computer skills including, Excel, Microsoft Word, and PowerPoint; Canva, GoFundMe.com and/or OneCause experience a plus

· Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

HolmeStage is a Los Angeles home staging company. We furnish and style homes that are going on the market so they photograph beautifully and sell faster. We own our inventory and run our own warehouse and install crews. We are a small, fast\-moving team.

About the Role

We are hiring one sharp, organized person to run our operations desk day to day. You are the first voice clients hear, the person who books the calendar, and the person the field team counts on to have their day sorted before they get in the truck.

This is a long\-term position. We want someone who wants to grow with the company, not someone looking for a few months of filler work.

Pay: $20\.00 per hour to start. After a successful first month, your rate goes to $24\.00 per hour. We would rather pay well and keep one great person than keep replacing people.

Remote to start, on\-site later: You will work from home for the first few months. Once we open our Downtown Los Angeles warehouse (roughly 4 to 5 months out), this becomes an on\-site role, so you should live within a reasonable commute of Downtown LA.

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with one unpaid hour for lunch. 40 hours per week. No nights, no weekends.

What You Will Do

* Answer incoming calls and texts, and return every missed call the same day
* Book and confirm appointments, and keep the company calendar accurate and conflict\-free
* Answer client emails clearly, professionally and fast
* Work daily in our CRM (Odoo): leads, clients, quotes, orders and follow\-ups
* Work in our phone system (CallTrackingMetrics / CTM): call logs, texts and routing
* Prepare and send quotes and paperwork, and chase them until they are signed
* Keep the team organized: schedules, reminders, documents and loose ends
* General office and administrative support, whatever keeps the day running smoothly

What We Are Looking For

* 2\+ years in an administrative, coordinator, front\-desk, dispatch or customer service role
* Excellent phone manner and excellent written English
* Genuinely organized. You keep lists, you follow up, and nothing falls through the cracks
* Fast learner who is comfortable with software. We will train you on Odoo and CTM, but you should be the kind of person who figures systems out instead of waiting to be shown twice
* Reliable and consistent. This job runs on being at your desk at 8:00 every morning
* Comfortable working independently from home now, and on\-site at the warehouse later
* A quiet home workspace and reliable high\-speed internet for the remote period

Nice to Have

* CRM experience (Odoo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or similar)
* Background in real estate, home staging, interior design, moving, construction, or any service business that schedules field crews

What We Offer

* $20\.00 per hour to start, going to $24\.00 per hour after a successful first month
* Paid on payroll (W2\)
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Monday to Friday schedule with no nights and no weekends
* A long\-term seat on a growing team, with real ownership of how the office runs

To Apply

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a short note about why this role fits you.

HolmeStage is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Account Manager – Industrial Electrical Services**

**Company:** GRC Industrial, LLC

**Location:** Anaheim, CA — Hybrid, with travel to customer locations for job walks

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary with uncapped performance incentives based on sales and project profitability

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, PTO, vehicle allowance or company vehicle, phone/laptop

**About GRC Industrial**

GRC Industrial, LLC is an industrial electrical contractor serving manufacturing clients across California, Arizona, and Nevada. We deliver electrical construction, facility upgrade, and equipment installation projects for some of the most demanding industrial environments in the region — from process plants to high\-tech manufacturing facilities.

**Our Core Values**

At GRC Industrial, we believe great results come from great teams. We work hard, support each other, take pride in what we do, and want to build a company where people enjoy working together.

We value a team\-first mentality, open communication, collaboration, professionalism, accountability, and respect. We expect our leaders to take ownership, approach challenges constructively, work together toward solutions, value the expertise of both our office and field teams, and bring a positive attitude to work each day.

Success at GRC isn’t just about individual performance — it’s about delivering great results while helping the people around you succeed and building a company we’re all proud to be part of.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Account Manager to grow and manage relationships with industrial manufacturing clients — specifically in the food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace sectors. You’ll be the face of GRC Industrial to plant managers, facility engineers, project managers, and procurement teams, identifying electrical construction and maintenance opportunities and turning them into won work.

This is a hunter\-and\-farmer role: you’ll develop new accounts in our target verticals while deepening relationships with existing clients to capture repeat and negotiated work.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, pursue, and win industrial electrical projects (installations, upgrades, expansions, equipment hookups, controls, and maintenance contracts) with food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace manufacturers
* Build and maintain relationships with plant engineering, facilities, maintenance, and capital projects teams at target accounts
* Develop a territory plan and pipeline; track opportunities from lead through award
* Partner with our estimating team on scope reviews, walk\-downs, RFIs, and proposal strategy to ensure bids match what the client actually needs
* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site walks; gather field intelligence that sharpens our pricing and win rate
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contract scope in coordination with leadership
* Stay in front of clients through the life of a project — handling change order conversations, resolving issues, and setting up the next opportunity
* Represent GRC Industrial at industry events, trade associations, and networking functions
* Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, and activity reporting

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 3\+ years of B2B sales or account management experience in electrical contracting, industrial construction, MEP services, or a closely related trade
* Working knowledge of industrial electrical systems and construction project delivery (bid/spec, design\-build, negotiated work)
* Proven track record of winning and growing accounts with industrial or manufacturing clients
* Ability to read plans and specs well enough to have credible technical conversations with facility engineers
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites for job walks and client meetings

**Preferred:**

* Existing relationships in food \& beverage, automotive, or aerospace manufacturing
* Field experience as an electrician, electrical PM, or estimator
* Familiarity with safety prequalification systems (ISNetworld, Avetta) and GMP/cleanroom environments
* Experience with CRM software and construction takeoff/estimating workflows

**Why GRC Industrial**

* Established contractor with a strong reputation and repeat industrial client base
* Direct access to leadership — your input shapes which work we chase
* Uncapped earning potential tied to the business you bring in

Pay: $61,647\.43 \- $74,242\.06 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Anaheim, CA 92806

jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone\-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.


Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone\-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone\-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone\-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.

**SUMMARY**


Yondr is seeking an Account Manager / Sales Lead to drive new business and manage key client relationships across the Shows vertical. Reporting to the Director of Music \& Events, this role sits at the intersection of artist relations and commercial execution — owning outreach and deal development with artist teams, agents, and promoters while ensuring seamless account management for confirmed tours and engagements. The ideal candidate is relationship\-driven, commercially sharp, and deeply fluent in the live entertainment ecosystem.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Business Development \& Sales***

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities across music, comedy, and adjacent live entertainment verticals.
* Conduct proactive outreach to artist managers, booking agents, and promoters to develop and convert new Yondr shows.
* Own end\-to\-end deal management from initial pitch through contract execution, working closely with the Director on pricing, proposals, and negotiation.
* Maintain and grow a qualified pipeline of prospective artists and tours, with consistent forecasting and reporting to the Director.
* Support expansion into underdeveloped verticals including EDM, Country, sports, and emerging markets — with Theater and Broadway as active near\-term priorities.
* Collaborate with the Director on agency and promoter relationship strategy, including participation in key industry conferences and events.

***Account Management***

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact for a portfolio of confirmed Shows clients.
* Manage client expectations, coordinate logistics, and ensure a high level of service from deal close through show execution.
* Collaborate closely with the Production team to ensure seamless handoff of confirmed engagements.
* Identify upsell and extension opportunities within existing accounts, including multi\-show and touring deals.
* Collect and track final ticket counts, billing documentation, and post\-show reporting.

***Relationship Development***

* Build and maintain strong, ongoing relationships with artist teams, agencies, promoters, and venues.
* Represent Yondr at industry events, showcases, and conferences in alignment with the department's visibility strategy.
* Contribute to the development of vertical sales materials, pitch decks, and artist testimonials in partnership with the Director and Marketing.

***Operations \& Reporting***

* Maintain accurate deal and client records in Airtable and internal systems.
* Support pipeline tracking, forecasting, and margin reporting in coordination with the Director and Finance.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives including pricing strategy, contract overhaul, and new service rollouts.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5–8 years of experience in artist relations, talent agency, music business, promotions, or live entertainment sales.
* Established relationships across the live entertainment ecosystem — artist management, booking agencies, promoters, or venues.
* Proven track record of closing deals and managing long\-term client relationships in a commercial context.
* Strong commercial instincts including comfort with pricing, proposals, and contract negotiation.
* Relationship\-driven and non\-transactional — able to build trust with artist teams and industry partners.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable representing Yondr externally.
* Experience with Airtable, CRM platforms, or pipeline management tools.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy.
* International experience is a plus, particularly in European touring or EDM markets.
* Genuine enthusiasm for and fluency in the live entertainment landscape.

**YONDR BENIFITS**

* 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15\+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP
* Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short\-term disability, long\-term disability and life insurance
* Generous PTO for rest and recharge throughout the year
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* 1 week paid holiday break at the end of December, for a company\-wide closure \+ 11 additional nationally recognized holidays
* 401(k) offering
* Tech tool preference, including choice of PC or Mac.
* Hybrid employees receive catered lunch twice a week.

*Yondr is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring of employees based on race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.*

Compensation Range: $80K \- $90K

jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced **Freelance Social Media Manager** to support an established hair and beauty business based in Inglewood.

This is a good fit for someone who can take ownership of the social media function, bring ideas to the table, and keep content moving without needing constant direction. We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for content to be handed to them and posts it.

**This is a remote 1099 independent contractor opportunity, not an employee position.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and manage monthly content plans that support consistent daily posting across the brand’s social platforms
* Batch\-create and prepare content in advance to maintain a consistent daily content cadence
* Help identify content themes, campaigns, and opportunities that make sense for the brand
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that strengthen the overall social media direction
* Write engaging captions, calls to action, and other social copy that align with the brand’s voice
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant social platforms
* Repurpose existing photo and video assets into additional social content
* Plan and communicate what photo and video content should be captured to support upcoming content plans, campaigns, and social media needs
* Create shot lists, content briefs, or other guidance that helps the person responsible for content capture understand what is needed
* Organize social media content and digital assets for easy access and reuse
* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content
* Stay aware of relevant social media trends and identify the ones that make sense for the brand
* Communicate proactively about content needs, approvals, priorities, and opportunities

**What We’re Looking For**

You should have demonstrated experience managing social media for a business or brand and be comfortable taking meaningful ownership of your work.

**The ideal candidate:**

* Has professional social media management experience
* Can demonstrate previous work through a portfolio, examples, or relevant accounts
* Understands how brand voice, audience, goals, and positioning should influence content
* Is comfortable developing ideas and making recommendations
* Can work independently while knowing when client input or approval is needed
* Has strong written communication and copywriting skills
* Understands short\-form video and social\-first content
* Understands what makes strong photo and video content for social media and can provide clear direction for content capture
* Is comfortable batching, planning, and scheduling content in advance
* Is organized and able to manage content calendars, deadlines, approvals, and digital assets
* Can interpret basic social media performance data and use it to improve future content
* Is reliable, responsive, and comfortable working directly with a business owner

*Experience with hair, beauty, lifestyle, or other visually driven consumer brands is a plus, but it’s not required.*

**Experience with social media strategy is also a bonus.** While this role is primarily focused on social media management and execution, we’d love someone who can contribute thoughtful ideas, help shape content direction, and make recommendations based on the brand’s goals and performance.

**This May Not Be a Fit If...**

This opportunity may not be the right fit if your experience is primarily limited to scheduling pre\-created posts or you prefer receiving detailed instructions for every piece of content.

We’re looking for someone who can bring strong execution, initiative, creativity, and good judgment to the role.

jobs.title: HR Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary


We're looking for an HR Operations Coordinator to handle the day\-to\-day processing of employee lifecycle transactions for Riser Fitness, including onboarding, employee changes, leave of absence administration, and offboarding. This is a hands\-on administrative role: you'll enter records, collect and verify paperwork, process changes in Rippling, triage the shared HR inbox, and keep employee files organized and accurate from a new hire's first day through their last. You'll take direction from the HR Operations Manager and work alongside Talent Acquisition and Payroll to keep every transaction moving on time.


Core Responsibilities


Onboarding

* Process new hire onboarding paperwork and system setup, from offer acceptance through Day 1
* Enter and update new hire records in Rippling, including personal information, compensation, and job details, as directed by the HR Operations Manager
* Collect and verify new hire documentation, including I\-9s, tax forms, and employment eligibility paperwork
* Send new hire paperwork and welcome communications, and follow up to make sure everything is completed on time
* Request system and platform access (Rippling, email, and studio\-level tools) and coordinate equipment issuance for new hires ahead of their start date


Employee Changes

* Process pay, title, position, and location changes in Rippling as directed by the HR Operations Manager
* Prepare and send change paperwork (offer letters, addendums, notices) and confirm employee acknowledgment
* Update personnel records to reflect approved changes and confirm accuracy against source approvals
* Route compensation or classification changes to Payroll and confirm they land in the correct pay cycle


Leave of Absence (LOA) Administration

* Process leave of absence requests and paperwork, including FMLA, state\-mandated leave, and personal/medical leave
* Track LOA dates, required certifications, and deadlines, and follow up with employees and managers on outstanding documentation
* Update Rippling records to reflect leave status, and route leave\-related pay and benefits changes to Payroll and Benefits
* Send leave\-related communications, including approval notices and return\-to\-work confirmations
* Maintain the LOA tracker and flag upcoming leave starts, returns, or expirations to the HR Operations Manager


Offboarding

* Process offboarding paperwork and checklist items for departing employees, including exit documentation
* Deactivate system and platform access and confirm return of company equipment on or before the last day
* Coordinate with Payroll to ensure final pay and benefits cessation details are handed off accurately
* Update personnel records to reflect termination details and rehire eligibility as directed


HR Inbox Triage

* Monitor the shared HR inbox and triage incoming requests, routing each to the correct owner (Payroll, Benefits, HR Operations Manager, or self)
* Respond directly to routine employee and manager questions on lifecycle, LOA, and general HR topics, escalating anything unclear

jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
Sales Department*Job Description* **Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.
The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role. **Work Arrangement**: On\-site, Hybrid \& Remote

**Multiple Locations**: CA, MN, TX, VA

**Compensation**: Competitive Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission (60/40 OTE Split \+ Performance Accelerators)**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.
* Drive sales for assigned accounts by building rapport, understanding account requirements, explaining product/service capabilities, negotiating contract terms, and finalizing contracts
* Expand sales (upsell) in assigned accounts by introducing new products and services
* Initiate sales process by scheduling appointments, making initial presentations, and understanding account requirements
* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled
* Monitor competition by gathering current marketplace information on pricing, products, new products, delivery schedules, and merchandising techniques
* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* **Build and maintain strong client relationships**
* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

 **Position Requirements*** BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products a plus.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------


Credit Genie is a mobile\-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long\-term financial stability.

  

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017\). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting\-edge technology and customer\-centric solutions.

**Overview:**

As an Integrated Marketing Lead at Credit Genie, you will be responsible for owning how our brand shows up across every channel our audience touches. This is a broad, senior individual\-contributor role that brings brand marketing, social media, and influencer marketing under one roof, with the ownership to set strategy and execute it.


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

**What You'll Do:**


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

* **Be a brand ambassador.** Act as a champion and guardian of the Credit Genie brand executing our positioning, voice, and visual identity consistently across every touchpoint, and building brand awareness and consideration through on\-brand creative and brand\-building programs, including brand campaigns across channels such as OOH, video, and digital.
* **Build and own social strategy.** Establish Credit Genie's social media strategy from the ground up and own it end to end across all major platforms. Partner with the design team to develop campaigns, manage the content pipeline and editorial calendar, maintain a consistent brand presence, and tailor content to the strengths and audience of each platform.
* **Own influencer and creator marketing end to end.** Own the strategy and execute the full program: sourcing, vetting, briefing, contracting, content review, and reporting. Turning partnerships into organic growth in following and recognition.
* **Build the employer brand.** Partner with the people team to tell Credit Genie's story as a place to work. Culture and employee content that attracts talent and a strong presence on platforms like LinkedIn and Glassdoor.
* **Own integrated go\-to\-market.** Translate business goals into integrated campaigns that span brand, social, influencer, PR, OOH, and lifecycle channels — owning them from concept through launch and optimization as one coherent story.

* Proven track record of building awareness and consideration

* Experience managing and measuring both ongoing and campaign\-specific social programs.

* Strong analytical skills and experience with web and social media analytics tools and reporting (e.g., Hootsuite, Google Analytics, Sprout Social, Tableau).

jobs.description:
Stanford University's Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Spine Division is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2\) to support the research program. This position plays a central and independent role in managing all aspects of PI’s research portfolio, including industry\-funded clinical trials, multi\-site collaborations, registry studies, and grant\-funded projects including PI\-Initiated projects. The CRC2 serves as the primary research contact for sponsors, collaborators, IRBs, and internal stakeholders, and will work closely with surgical faculty, residents, fellows, and students.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced research professional seeking meaningful responsibility in a dynamic academic medical center environment.


Must possess and maintain a valid California non\-commercial Class C Driver’s License.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**

* Ability to drive day or night.
* Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping.
* Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds.
* Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

*\* \- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.*

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious diseases and infections.
May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs  
* 

**WORK STANDARDS:**

* When conducting university business, must comply with California Vehicle Code and Stanford University driving requirements.
* Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.
* Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.
* Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu .

  
**Core Duties** :


* Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
* Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.
* Develop project schedules, targets, measurements, and accountabilities, as assigned. Lead team meetings and prepare/approve minutes.
* Formally supervise, train, and/or mentor new staff or students, as assigned, potentially including hiring, preparing or assisting with the preparation of performance evaluations, and performing related duties, in addition to instruction on project work.
* Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions and respond to requests and questions.
* Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
* Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
* Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
* Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study documents to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
* Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
Knowledge of medical terminology.  
* 

**Certificates and Licenses Required**

Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

A growing U.S.\-based digital out\-of\-home (DOOH) media and advertising network company is seeking Business Development Representatives to support its expansion across major U.S. markets.

The company partners with commercial and residential properties to transform elevators, building lobbies, and other high\-traffic spaces into premium digital communication channels.

* Work directly with company founders and leadership and receive hands\-on mentorship.
* Build relationships with property owners, asset managers, and property management professionals.
* Earn **uncapped commission** based on screens successfully installed.
* Gain exposure to market development, outbound campaigns, partnerships, and go\-to\-market strategy.
